aws_sqs_queue.attributes: The queue's read-only attributes as returned by the SQS API (for example ApproximateNumberOfMessages, QueueArn), keyed by attribute name.
aws_sqs_queue.queue_name: The name of the SQS queue.
aws_sqs_queue.queue_url: The URL identifying the created SQS queue.
aws_sqs_queue.tags: Key-value tags attached to the queue.
